title: CakeEventManager regression in 2.5

milestone.description:
Backwards compatible enhancements and improvements to the 2.x release series.

See [the roadmap](https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/wiki/2.5-roadmap) for additional information.

body:
I'm getting errors when running Croogo tests.

Bisected to commit 3e373771d7f7ec5eb821a5ed41f10e5dc0a4efce that is squashed from #1638.  See bisect log below.

Reverting that commit allow tests to pass again.
